<style>
/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   WellSource Design System — OKLCH Palette
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
:root {
  /* Primary — Teal */
  --color-primary:        oklch(52% 0.118 200);

  --color-primary-light:  oklch(72% 0.06 195);

  --space-5:  32px;
  --space-6:  48px;
  --space-7:  64px;

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════

  justify-content: center;
  position: relative;
}

.hero-image-placeholder::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 30% 40%, oklch(90% 0.06 200 / 0.6) 0%, transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 70% 60%, oklch(85% 0.08 180 / 0.4) 0%, transparent 50%);
}

.hero-img-icon {
  font-size: 120px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  opacity: 0.8;
}

.challenge-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: var(--space-4);
  right: var(--space-4);
  background: var(--color-accent);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  text-align: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}
.challenge-badge span {
  display: block;
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: 800;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Content Grid (Trending + Newsletter)
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.content-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
}

.content-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 380px;
  gap: var(--space-6);
}

/* Trending */
.trending-card {
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-5);
}

.trending-title {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.trending-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}

.trending-item {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding: var(--space-3);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
}
.trending-item:hover {
  background: var(--color-bg-warm);
  border-color: var(--color-border-light);
}

.trending-item-num {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
  line-height: 1;
  min-width: 32px;
}

.trending-item-content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 2px;
}

.trending-item-category {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.trending-item-title {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text);
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.trending-item:hover .trending-item-title {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* Newsletter CTA Card */
.newsletter-card {
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, var(--color-primary), oklch(48% 0.10 210));
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-5);
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.newsletter-card-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 24px;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.newsletter-card h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-2xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.newsletter-card p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  opacity: 0.85;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.newsletter-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}

.newsletter-form input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  border: 2px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.2);
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.1);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.newsletter-form input::placeholder {
  color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.5);
}
.newsletter-form input:focus {
  border-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.5);
}

.newsletter-form .btn {
  background: #fff;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.newsletter-form .btn:hover {
  background: var(--color-bg-warm);
  color: var(--color-primary-hover);
  transform: none;
  box-shadow: none;
}

.newsletter-privacy {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  opacity: 0.6;
  margin-top: var(--space-2);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Health Topics Carousel
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
}

.section-header-group {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}

.carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}

.carousel-viewport {
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
}

.carousel-track {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-4);
  transition: transform var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-in-out);
}

.topic-card {
  flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 48px) / 4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-3);
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.topic-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.topic-card-image {
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 42px;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.topic-card-label {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text);
  text-align: center;
}

.carousel-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--color-text);
  z-index: 10;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.carousel-btn:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
}
.carousel-btn--prev { left: -18px; }
.carousel-btn--next { right: -18px; }

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Health Tools
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.tools-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
  background: var(--color-bg-warm);
}

.tools-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-5);
}

.tools-card {
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-5);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
}

.tools-card h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.tools-card > p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
}

.tool-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}

.tool-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--space-3);
  padding: var(--space-3);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  transition: background var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.tool-item:hover {
  background: var(--color-bg-cool);
}

.tool-item-icon {
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 20px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tool-item-info h4 {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.tool-item-info p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.tools-card-cta {
  margin-top: var(--space-4);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Recommended Reads — Tabs
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.reads-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
}

.tabs-nav {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-1);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  padding-bottom: 2px;
}

.tab-btn {
  padding: 10px 20px;
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
  position: relative;
}
.tab-btn:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
}
.tab-btn.active {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
}

.articles-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-4);
  transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out);
}

.article-card {
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.article-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.article-card-image {
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 48px;
}

.article-card-body {
  padding: var(--space-4);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}

.article-card-category {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.article-card-title {
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--color-text);
}
.article-card:hover .article-card-title {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.article-card-meta {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  margin-top: auto;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Trust Pillars
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.trust-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
  background: var(--color-bg-cool);
}

.trust-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
}

.trust-header .section-heading {
  max-width: 600px;
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.trust-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-4);
}

.trust-pillar {
  text-align: center;
  padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-4);
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.trust-pillar:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.trust-pillar-icon {
  width: 64px;
  height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 28px;
  margin: 0 auto var(--space-4);
}

.trust-pillar h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-lg);
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
  color: var(--color-text);
}

.trust-pillar p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: var(--color-text-secondary);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Featured Programs
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.programs-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
}

.programs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-4);
}

.program-card {
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.program-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.program-card-image {
  aspect-ratio: 3/2;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 40px;
}

.program-card-body {
  padding: var(--space-4);
}

.program-card-body h4 {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--color-text);
  line-height: 1.3;
}
.program-card:hover .program-card-body h4 {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Latest Videos
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.videos-section {
  padding: var(--space-7) 0;
  background: var(--color-bg-warm);
}

.videos-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: var(--space-4);
}

.video-card {
  background: var(--color-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.video-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  border-color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.video-card-thumb {
  aspect-ratio: 16/9;
  background: var(--color-primary-pale);
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 40px;
}

.video-play-btn {
  position: absolute;
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.65);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 22px;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.video-card:hover .video-play-btn {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  transform: scale(1.1);
}

.video-card-body {
  padding: var(--space-4);
}
.video-card-body h4 {
  font-size: var(--text-base);
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-text);
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.video-card:hover .video-card-body h4 {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Footer
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.site-footer {
  background: var(--color-text);
  color: oklch(80% 0.01 260);
  padding: var(--space-7) 0 var(--space-5);
}

.footer-newsletter {
  background: oklch(28% 0.01 260);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: var(--space-5);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-5);
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.footer-newsletter-text {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 250px;
}

.footer-newsletter-text h3 {
  font-size: var(--text-xl);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-1);
}

.footer-newsletter-text p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: oklch(70% 0.01 260);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.footer-newsletter .newsletter-form {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  min-width: 300px;
}

.footer-newsletter .newsletter-form input {
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08);
  border-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.12);
  color: #fff;
}

.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
  gap: var(--space-6);
  margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
  padding-bottom: var(--space-5);
  border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.08);
}

.footer-brand p {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: oklch(70% 0.01 260);
  margin-top: var(--space-3);
  max-width: 280px;
}

.footer-col h4 {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #fff;
  margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}

.footer-links {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-2);
}

.footer-links a {
  font-size: var(--text-sm);
  color: oklch(70% 0.01 260);
  transition: color var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.footer-links a:hover {
  color: var(--color-primary-light);
}

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--space-4);
}

.footer-bottom p {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: oklch(60% 0.01 260);
}

.footer-social {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-3);
}

.footer-social a {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.06);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: oklch(80% 0.01 260);
  font-size: 16px;
  transition: all var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-out);
}
.footer-social a:hover {
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: #fff;
}

.footer-legal {
  font-size: var(--text-xs);
  color: oklch(55% 0.01 260);
  margin-top: var(--space-4);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Loading shimmer for tab transitions
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); }
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.articles-grid.switching {
  opacity: 0.5;
}
.articles-grid .article-card {
  animation: fadeIn var(--duration-slow) var(--ease-out) both;
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Section divider
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
.section-alt {
  background: var(--color-bg-warm);
}

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
   Responsive Design
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  .hero-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
  .hero-image {
    max-height: 360px;
    order: -1;
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: var(--text-4xl);
  }

  .content-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .tools-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .articles-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .trust-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .programs-grid,
  .videos-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }

  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  }

  .topic-card {
    flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 16px) / 2);
  }

  .main-nav {
    display: none;
  }
  .mobile-menu-btn {
    display: flex;
  }
  .header-actions .btn-ghost:first-child {
    display: none;
  }

  .carousel-btn--prev { left: 8px; }
  .carousel-btn--next { right: 8px; }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  :root {
    --header-height: 56px;
  }

  .hero {
    padding: var(--space-4) 0;
  }
  .hero-title {
    font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  }
  .hero-subtitle {
    font-size: var(--text-base);
  }
  .hero-actions {
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  .hero-image {
    aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  }

  .section-heading {
    font-size: var(--text-3xl);
  }

  .articles-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .trust-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .programs-grid,
  .videos-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .footer-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .topic-card {
    flex: 0 0 calc(100% - 8px);
  }

  .tabs-nav {
    gap: 4px;
  }
  .tab-btn {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
  }

  .newsletter-form {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .footer-newsletter {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .footer-newsletter .newsletter-form {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .section-header {
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: var(--space-3);
  }

  .challenge-badge {
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
  }
  .challenge-badge span {
    font-size: var(--text-lg);
  }

<script>

// Mega Menu
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
  const overlay = document.getElementById('navOverlay');
  let activeMenu = null;

  function closeAll() {
    navItems.forEach(item => {
      item.classList.remove('active');
      item.querySelector('.nav-trigger').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    });
    overlay.classList.remove('visible');
    activeMenu = null;
  }

  navItems.forEach(item => {
    const trigger = item.querySelector('.nav-trigger');
    trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (item.classList.contains('active')) {
        closeAll();
      } else {
        closeAll();
        item.classList.add('active');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        overlay.classList.add('visible');
        activeMenu = item;
      }
    });
  });

  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeAll);

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') closeAll();
  });

  // Hover to switch between menus when one is open
  navItems.forEach(item => {
    const trigger = item.querySelector('.nav-trigger');
    trigger.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
      if (activeMenu && activeMenu !== item) {
        closeAll();
        item.classList.add('active');
        trigger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        overlay.classList.add('visible');
        activeMenu = item;
      }
    });
  });
})();

  });

})();

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// Health Topics Carousel
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
(function() {
  let position = 0;
  const track = document.getElementById('topicsTrack');
  const cards = track.querySelectorAll('.topic-card');

  function getCardsPerView() {
    if (window.innerWidth <= 640) return 1;
    if (window.innerWidth <= 1024) return 2;
    return 4;
  }

  function getCardWidth() {
    const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
    const gap = cardsPerView === 1 ? 8 : 16;
    return (track.parentElement.clientWidth - (gap * (cardsPerView - 1))) / cardsPerView;
  }

  window.scrollTopics = function(direction) {
    const cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
    const maxPos = Math.max(0, cards.length - cardsPerView);
    position = Math.max(0, Math.min(position + direction, maxPos));
    const cardWidth = getCardWidth();
    const gap = cardsPerView === 1 ? 8 : 16;
    track.style.transform = `translateX(-${position * (cardWidth + gap)}px)`;
  };

  // Reset on resize
  window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
    position = 0;
    track.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';

})();

steps.message:
The WellSource homepage is built at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what's included:

**All 11 sections** from the brief:
- **Sticky header** with mega-menu navigation (5 dropdowns: Health Conditions, Wellness, Tools, Featured, Connect)
- **Credibility ticker** — auto-scrolling stat bar (4 stats on seamless loop, pauses on hover)
- **Hero** — fitness challenge article with badge, title, subtitle, dual CTAs
- **Trending + Newsletter** — sidebar layout with 4 trending articles and a newsletter CTA card
- **Health topics carousel** — 6 circular-image cards with prev/next arrows, responsive slides
- **Health tools** — Nutrition Hub and Drug & Care Tools in 2-column grid
- **Recommended reads** — 6 tab categories with snappy tab switching (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, Product Reviews, Recipes, Skin Care), each with their own article data
- **Trust pillars** — 4 pillars with icons and descriptions
- **Featured programs** — 4 program cards
- **Latest videos** — 4 video cards with play buttons
- **Footer** — newsletter, link columns, social, legal disclaimer

**Design**: Brand colors in OKLCH (`--color-primary: oklch(52% 0.118 200)` teal), Inter font, 8px spacing scale, content-based responsive breakpoints (640px / 1024px), mobile hamburger nav with accordion groups, rounded corners, subtle shadows.

**Interactive features**: All 5 interactions from `task_input.json` are implemented — mega-menu toggles, tab switching with fade animation, carousel with arrow navigation, newsletter form with success feedback, and continuous ticker animation.
